name: hero-video-dialog

frames.best_why: The only frame showing the whole clickable thumbnail with its frosted halo and white play button at rest.

tagline: A thumbnail with a frosted play button opens a full-screen video.
summary: A click-to-play video card: the round play button on the thumbnail opens a blurred full-screen dialog holding the embedded video, springing in from a chosen side.
appearance: A rounded video thumbnail on a black stage, a dark dashboard screenshot under a blue-to-purple gradient with a white headline. A white circular play button wrapped in a frosted halo sits centred on it.
behaviour: Clicking the thumbnail opens a full-screen blurred backdrop with the video in a rounded white-bordered frame that springs in. The dialog closes on its X, the Escape key, or a click outside.
demo_content: The thumbnail reads "You Need This UI Library" over a dashboard; the video is a Next.js build tutorial.
search_phrases: click thumbnail to play a video
hero video pops up on click
play button on a preview image
launch a video from a card
use_when: A landing page wants a promo video kept one click away without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Slow connections: the dialog opens onto a blank, unlabelled iframe while the video loads.
customise: Video URL, thumbnail URL, alt text and one of eight entry animations are props; overlay tint and close-button styling live in the source.
weight_why: One image, a button and an iframe that only mounts while the dialog is open.

a11y.note: Opens and closes by keyboard, but focus is not trapped in the dialog or returned to the thumbnail, and there is no reduced-motion guard.

issues: The close button is an icon with no accessible label.
polish_why: Clean thumbnail and smooth spring modal; the loading frame is plain and the close button unlabelled.
